title: Yan Shigu
shortSummary: Yan Shigu connects early Tang textual editing and commentary with state knowledge projects.
curatorialDescription: His record shows that textual scholarship was not isolated study but was connected to official learning, editions and institutions.
researchNote: Specific editorial projects, edition histories and offices still require volume- and page-level sources.
